data.rationale: Host WS-FIN-0142 has a prior true positive for suspicious rundll32 network activity, and user l.hassan is now associated with SMB lateral movement (T1021.002) targeting FS-CORP-03. The presence of related SMB share enumeration on the same destination IP 10.20.30.12 reinforces active reconnaissance or staging behavior. This correlation between a confirmed malicious host and new lateral movement warrants immediate investigation.
suggested_actions: Review EDR telemetry on WS-FIN-0142 for process trees and command lines associated with the prior rundll32 true positive and current SMB activity.
Inspect SMB session logs on FS-CORP-03 (10.20.30.12) to determine if user l.hassan accessed or modified sensitive files during the connection from 10.20.14.88.
Correlate authentication logs for l.hassan across both hosts to identify anomalous login times or credential usage patterns.
Check network flow data between 10.20.14.88 and 10.20.30.12 for unusual volume or file transfer indicators consistent with T1570 Lateral Tool Transfer.
